usedFor: Deputy holds employees and locations, and HubSpot stores each new employee as a contact through “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Employee” in Deputy, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It looks up the contact by email, so an employee already in HubSpot is updated, not copied.

watchOut: “New Employee” in Deputy is polling, so new staff appear in HubSpot only after a scheduled check.
